coverageNote: Public standings checked November 1 at 7:56 pm EST (November 2, 00:56 UTC). Two-week comparisons use the saved October 19 baseline for continuously tracked entries. Final medals follow the private evaluation.
dek: Four places gained and 6.26 points added: the juggernaut is on the move. Above the chase, Yi-Chia Chen leads Tufa into the final day.

image.caption: Board checked Nov 1, 2026 · 7:56 PM EST.

sections.heading: At the front
sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model enters the final day on 75.56, with Tufa Labs on 70.24. Yi-Chia Chen’s advantage is a little over five points. The pair have opened a wide gap over the chasing pack, but there is still a full day’s worth of pressure to absorb. Across on ARC-2, their positions are reversed: Tufa is trying to hold off Yi-Chia Chen there while chasing Yi-Chia Chen here.

sections.heading: The field keeps moving
sections.text: Yukai Liu supplied the newest jolt, jumping from 671st to 39th as six more points lifted the score to 36.96. Earlier, UNK climbed into the gold places and now stands 17th on 41.00. K.nosaka, tomo11111 and Luxshan Thavarasa also reached the top hundred on Sunday.

sections.heading: The long climb
sections.text: yktori has risen from 34th to seventh over the past two weeks, adding 15.01 points. UNK has climbed from 111th to 17th with a gain of 7.81. Near the public gold line, the margins are brutally small: The ARChitects is 16th on 41.03, UNK has 41.00, and Vineeth Sai Varikuntla follows on 40.98. The gold places run through 20th in a field of 5,035 teams.

sections.heading: One day to answer
sections.text: Watch Tufa’s pursuit of Yi-Chia Chen, NVARC3’s hold on fourth and the teams around twentieth place before Monday’s 23:59 UTC deadline.
